----Petitioners  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through PP
----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Tribhuvan Singh.

For Respondent(s) : Mr. A.R. Choudhary, PP.
 Mr. Pradeep Kumar Shah.
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 21/07/2023

This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioners who have been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.74/2023 registered at Police Station Chouhtan, District Barmer, for offences under Sections 450, 376(D) and 354 IPC.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned Public Prosecutor so also learned counsel for the complainant.
Perused the material available on record.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that petitioners have been falsely implicated in the present case.
Learned counsel submitted that for the alleged incident of 27.03.2023, the FIR has been lodged by the complainant on 29.03.2023.

[CRLMB-7979/2023] Drawing attention of the Court towards the charge-sheet submitted by the investigating agency, learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that from perusal of the CDR (Call Detail Record) analysis done by the investigating agency pertaining to mobile number of the petitioners and the prosecutrix, it is apparent that prosecutrix was in constant touch with the Babu Khan vs State Of Rajasthan on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146547848/
1 petitioner even prior to the date of alleged incident.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel submitted that the prosecutrix was having consensual relationship with the petitioner No.1 Babu Khan, however, on their relations turning strained, the petitioners have been roped in a false case.
Leaned counsel submitted that challan has already been filed and the trial of the case is likely to consume sufficiently long time.
On these grounds, he implored the Court to enlarge the petitioners on bail.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel for the complainant have opposed the bail application.
Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioners on bail.
Consequently, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioners (1) Babu Khan S/o Maluk Khan and (2) Saddam Khan S/o Ramdan Khan arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.74/2023 registered at Police Station Chouhtan, District Barmer, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided each of them furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/-
(3 of 3) [CRLMB-7979/2023] each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for their appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 210-Tikam/-
